title: Upper Bound on Universal Circuit Size
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and $f$ a Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables. The universal circuit representing $f$ has size at most $2^n(n+1)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps assignments of $n$ Boolean variables to a Boolean value
